// A default sees the parameters and the scopes around its function, never
// the body: a body declaration of the same name neither hides a source nor
// makes one. A line ending in "// flagged" must be reported; every other line
// must pass.
import * as os from 'node:os';
function shadowedEnv({ HOME } = process.env) { // flagged
  const process = { env: { HOME: 'fixture-home' } };
  return [HOME, process.env.HOME];
}
function shadowedOs({ homedir } = os) { // flagged
  const os = { homedir: () => 'fixture-home' };
  return [homedir(), os.homedir()];
}
function withFixtureOs() {
  const os = { homedir: () => 'fixture-home' };
  return async function fixtureDefault({ homedir } = os) {
    const os = await import('node:os');
    return [homedir(), os.homedir()]; // flagged
  };
}
function withFixtureProcess() {
  const process = { env: { HOME: 'fixture-home' } };
  return function fixtureDefault({ HOME } = process.env) {
    const process = require('node:process');
    return [HOME, process.env.HOME]; // flagged
  };
}
